concerns.text: The plan cites the HuggingFace dataset `FatimaSohailll/PPM-Image-Dataset-for-KLT-Feature-Tracking` as the source of the gut microbiome 16S rRNA ASV table. This dataset is an image‑tracking collection, not a microbiome ASV matrix, so it cannot provide the required taxonomic count data for the analysis.

The clinical metadata dataset `mcbuehler/pp_mixed_v0` does not contain the UPDRS Part III scores needed for computing per‑patient progression slopes, yet the implementation plan (FR‑004, FR‑005) assumes this variable is present. Using a dataset that lacks the primary outcome makes the analysis infeasible.
